governance_invariants: An individual objection may suspend active use but does not adjudicate the merits.
No individual, small group, institution, or Caeluviim maintainer may decide final status for the entire speaker body.
Final status requires a speaker-wide ballot under election rules first ratified by participating speakers.
Every reasonably reachable eligible speaker must have an equal opportunity to receive notice, deliberate, propose alternatives, and vote.
Failure to satisfy the speaker-ratified legitimacy conditions leaves the lexeme SUSPENDED_UNRESOLVED rather than granting default authority to the participating minority.
Replacement or removal ends active use while preserving a tombstoned provenance and dissent record.
